candidates.title: Hyderabad: Senior citizen loses Rs 2.20 crore in fake CBI call scam
candidates.excerpt: A 72-year-old Nampally woman allegedly lost Rs 2.20 crore after cybercriminals posing as CBI officials threatened her with arrest. Police said the fraudsters used a fake arrest warrant and demanded transfers under the pretext of avoiding legal action.

candidates.title: TG SAFE suspends licences of seven restaurants in Telangana districts
candidates.excerpt: TG SAFE has suspended the FSSAI licences of seven restaurants in three Telangana districts over serious food safety violations. Inspections found pest infestations, rotten vegetables, expired food and unhygienic kitchens. Officials also issued notices and ordered a separate restaurant to close.
